method: Read-only source, report and existing ASCII-STL audit; no CAD/export/test rerun, no production changes.

envelope_derivation.symbols: L in [26.98,27.02]; q in [-(L-26)/2, +(L-26)/2]; lo=1-L/2+q, hi=1+L/2+q. Front/back thicknesses may independently lie in [.9,1.1].
envelope_derivation.logic: Each separate solid is covered by its axial interval. The union drops correlations and may overfill, conservatively. Nominal radial registration only.

through_bore_source_check.body: Original ci_local_body minus D8.3 over z[-13,15]; fully passes axis body[-12,-4].
through_bore_source_check.cover: Original ci_local_cover minus D8.3 over z[7,15]; fully passes axis cover[8,14].

plastic_contacts.interpretation: Actual output is entirely defined end-stop surface contact at z=-12 or14. No skin subtraction.
plastic_contacts.review_script_gate: Latest review.py now checks each triangle lies wholly on one specified plane, closing the earlier per-vertex-only classification weakness.

neighbor_union.radial_exclusion_check: The D16.2 subtraction removes old main-axis hardware and OD16 thrust washers. The remaining M3 cheek, M6 adjuster and stop hardware are radially outside that exclusion cylinder.
rotor_probe: ci_local_moving_hardware(0), including bush, ball and terminal fasteners
neighbor_union.terminal_cap_analytic_check: Its blank is a radius7 hull of centers [0,54] and [0,66], so minimum radius>=47, unchanged by axial rotation. Entire axis envelope radius<=6. Cuts only remove material. Thus it is separated analytically, but absent from candidate assembly/section rendering.

rotor_rotation_argument.scope: Any angular rotation of the coaxial nominal rotor about local z, not eccentricity, bore offset, tilt, altered axial rotor stack, or free cable.

positive_control.interpretation: Real short-sleeve outer-washer overlap detected, not force/strength result.

scope_verdict: Only isolated nominal-radial coaxial continuous axial envelope and analytic rotor angular invariance. Not complete input rendering, global service/collision, catalogue approval, manufacturing release or physical acceptance.
